responsibility: Implements 32-bit x86 ABI classification across general and fastcall/vectorcall flavors, handling small-struct returns, byval stack passing and alignment for aggregates, scalar widening, and `InReg` marking of eligible integer arguments for fastcall-compatible conventions.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/x86.rs`, this x86 file performs 32-bit function-call ABI lowering across general and fastcall/vectorcall conventions, handling struct returns, byval aggregate passing, scalar extension, and `InReg` marking, rather than inline-assembly register syntax and aliasing.
